chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) that he was asked about the thrice-divorced woman
Does she have maintenance and residence? He said: Is she pregnant? I said: No. He said: Then no.

key_terms.المُطَلَّقَةِ ثَلَاثًا: The woman who has been given a triple divorce

ai.seo_question: Does a thrice-divorced woman receive maintenance and residence if she is not pregnant?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that a woman given a triple divorce (thalath) loses her right to maintenance (nafaqah) and residence (sukna) unless she is pregnant, as evidenced by the respondent's confirmation of her non-pregnant status. This ruling highlights the distinction between the waiting period (iddah) of a triple divorcee and other categories, emphasizing that financial support is contingent upon pregnancy in this specific context. The narration underscores the practical application of Quranic principles regarding divorce and post-divorce rights within Shia jurisprudence.
